verdict.rationale: Authy documents an encrypted backup feature for exactly this case: tokens are decrypted only with a user-held password (authy-docs-5). Its features page also covers adding new devices via SMS, voice or existing-device approval and removing lost or stolen devices (authy-docs-8, authy-docs-10, authy-docs-3). Community users corroborate recovery via a replacement SIM plus the backup password (authy-comm-19, authy-comm-6). Missing for 10: in-depth step-by-step first-party recovery docs (the evidence is only feature-page bullets), and any documented fallback if the backup password or phone number is also lost.
